# Ordinary script composition fixture

`TestOrdinaryScriptNativePreparationQuantizationAndScore` builds an unpublished
`prepare.py` with one `main(ctx)` and invokes it through the actual Creator CLI.

The carrier contains two BF16 16×64 `*.weight` tensors, 4096 payload bytes. The
registry was banked with the real native tool:

```
tfs ingest bank safetensors.diffusers diffusers.identity/1 \
  --source encoder=model.safetensors --registry registry.json \
  --source-profile fixture/quantize/1 --target encoder=plain/1 \
  --member encoder=provider/model.safetensors --order order.json \
  --source-name local-composition-fixture
```

The test-only Runtime launcher configures the actual native source controller to
use the loopback provider and this registry. The quantizer fixture calls the
production generic helper and pauses after its first real public/native checkpoint;
the harness pauses the owned request, kills its executor, and launches a fresh
edited script. No numerical kernel or successful protocol response is replaced.

The scoring package runs actual Cozy Eval metrics on the supplied, captured PNGs.
Those images were not generated by the checkpoint. This qualifies composition,
interruption and memoization; model quality and publication require separate proof.
